_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment, never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: kind: feature. REQ-BCF-013: the appointment records whether the confirmation request reached the mail server, so a failed send can be shown and resent. Written by ConfirmationTokenService after each send or resend, never by a user. REQ-BET-011: a booking records when its last reminder was sent and on which channel, written by BookingNotificationService after the reminder left. REQ-SMS-021: an SMS channel shows whether a real provider is bound (connectionState), and an appointment records its SMS reminder outcome, written by SmsReminderRunner. REQ-WSW-011: the key-lifecycle audit trail records a change of a key's allowed origins (origins-changed; lists merge, so this extends the action enum).

confirmationRequestStatus.title: Confirmation request
confirmationRequestStatus.description: Whether the last confirmation request was accepted by the mail server (sent) or not (failed). Empty until a request was tried.

confirmationRequestAt.title: Confirmation request tried at
confirmationRequestAt.description: When the last confirmation request was tried, ISO 8601.

smsReminderStatus.title: SMS reminder
smsReminderStatus.description: The outcome of the SMS reminder: handed to the provider (sent or pending), failed, or skipped (opted out, no number). Empty until the reminder was due.

smsReminderAt.title: SMS reminder tried at
smsReminderAt.description: When the SMS reminder was tried, ISO 8601.

smsReminderReference.title: SMS provider reference
smsReminderReference.description: The provider's reference for the reminder message, when it gave one.

lastReminderSentAt.title: Last reminder sent at
lastReminderSentAt.description: When the last reminder for this booking was accepted by its channel, ISO 8601. Empty until a reminder was sent.

lastReminderChannel.title: Last reminder channel
lastReminderChannel.description: The channel that accepted the last reminder, for example email or sms.

connectionState.title: Provider connection
connectionState.description: Whether an SMS provider is bound that can send (connected) or not (not-connected); while not connected no reminder is sent. Written by the reminder job.

action.title: Action
action.description: The lifecycle action that triggered the audit entry.
